subject: general
question: Choose the synonym of 'Docile'.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Pliable**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Docile"** means ready to accept control or instruction, submissive, or easy to teach or manage. (आज्ञाकारी या विनम्र)
 
 
• **Example:** The docile puppy obeyed every command from its owner.
 
 
• **"Pliable"** refers to something that is easily bent or flexible, but when used to describe a person, it means someone who is easily influenced or controlled. (लचीला या आसानी से प्रभावित होने वाला)
 
 
• **Example:** The young boy had a pliable mind, open to new ideas and teachings.
 
 
• Hence, "Pliable" is the correct synonym for "Docile."

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Pliable**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Reveal** (प्रकट करना): To make known or disclose something that was hidden or unknown.
 
 
• **Example:** The magician finally revealed the secret behind his trick.
 
 
 
• **Exhibit** (प्रदर्शित करना): To display or show something publicly.
 
 
• **Example:** The artist decided to exhibit her paintings at the local gallery.
 
 
 
• **Clarify** (स्पष्ट करना): To make something clear or easier to understand.
 
 
• **Example:** The teacher clarified the complex concept with a simple example.
